pairs.target: huò lù huì de cèmén tōngxiàng yìjiān zhǎi tīng . cìrì shàngwǔ , tǎ wéi gēn ruǎn héng jìnqù shí , qiánpái zhuōshàng yǐ bǎi zhe liángdài de fēng yàng hé jǐzhāng méi dān , hòupái yǒurén bào zhezhuāng xiānhuò de kōng kuāng , bùshí huàn yìzhī xīgài tuō zhe .
pairs.english: The freight route association's side door led to a narrow hall. When Tavi entered with Ruan Heng the next morning, sealed grain samples and several coal orders already lay on the front table; someone at the back held an empty fresh-produce basket, shifting it from knee to knee.
pairs.hanzi: 货路会的侧门通向一间窄厅。次日上午，塔维跟阮衡进去时，前排桌上已摆着粮袋的封样和几张煤单，后排有人抱着装鲜货的空筐，不时换一只膝盖托着。

pairs.target: xià róng hái méi lái , tǎ wéi tì tā liú zuò , hòulái rén jiànjiàn duō le , tā zhǐhǎo bǎ dā zài dèng shàng de wàiyī shōuhuí lái .
pairs.english: Xiarong hadn't arrived, so Tavi saved her a seat, but as people gradually filled the room he had to take back the coat draped on the bench.
pairs.hanzi: 夏绒还没来，塔维替她留座，后来人渐渐多了，他只好把搭在凳上的外衣收回来。

pairs.target: dǒnglǐ shìxiān bǎ qiángshàng de xiànlùtú zhǎnpíng . liǎngchù gāo cūn de dōng liáng shàngwèi bǔzú , běipō xiūlù yòu yào jǐ qù jǐrì chēchéng , liángshāng xīwàng wǎnghòu yígèyuè , měizhōu sāntiān de zǎobān xiān liúgěi liáng méi .
pairs.english: Director Dong first flattened the route map on the wall. Winter grain stocks in two high villages were still short, and northern-slope road repairs would cost several days of cart travel; a grain merchant wanted morning slots on three days each week reserved first for grain and coal for the next month.
pairs.hanzi: 董理事先把墙上的线路图展平。两处高村的冬粮尚未补足，北坡修路又要挤去几日车程，粮商希望往后一个月，每周三天的早班先留给粮煤。

pairs.target: tā shuōwán , hòupái bào kuāng de nánrén biàn wèn , nà sāngè zǎochén shèngxià de huò yào děngdào shénme shíhòu .
pairs.english: When she finished, the man holding the basket at the back asked how long the other goods would have to wait on those three mornings.
pairs.hanzi: 她说完，后排抱筐的男人便问，那三个早晨剩下的货要等到什么时候。

pairs.target: liángshāng shuō zǎo yùn shì wèile rùkù , dōngtiān bùnéng děng rén hǎn è le zài sòng . bào kuāng de rén jiāng kuāng dǐ fān gěi zhuōqián kàn , zhú fènglǐ hái niánzhuó càiyè .
pairs.english: The grain merchant said early transport was for storage: in winter they couldn't wait for people to cry hunger before delivering. The basket holder turned its bottom toward the table; vegetable leaves still clung in the bamboo gaps.
pairs.hanzi: 粮商说早运是为了入库，冬天不能等人喊饿了再送。抱筐的人将筐底翻给桌前看，竹缝里还粘着菜叶。

pairs.target: tā de huò méifǎ xiāncún yígèyuè , yě bùnéng ràng mǎi de rén dōu děngdào bàngwǎn . liǎng rén yuè shuō yuè xiǎng , dǒng lǐshì qiāo le yíxià zhuōzi , jiào jìlù de rén bǎ gèzì yào de bāncì xiān fēnkāi xiě .
pairs.english: His goods couldn't be stored a month ahead, nor could all the buyers wait until evening. The two grew louder as they spoke; Director Dong tapped the table and told the record keeper to write down their requested slots separately first.
pairs.hanzi: 他的货没法先存一个月，也不能让买的人都等到傍晚。两人越说越响，董理事敲了一下桌子，叫记录的人把各自要的班次先分开写。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhè cái kànqīng , liáng méi yě bìng búshì yìjiā de huò . yǒu cūnlǐ hézī mǎi de liáng , yǒu liǎngjiā huòzhàn tì lú fāng cún de méi , yě yǒu gòngnuǎn gōngwū nà fèn hái méi jiéqīng de jiùzhàng .
pairs.english: Only then did Tavi see clearly that the grain and coal weren't all one owner's cargo. There was grain jointly bought by villagers, coal stored by two freight warehouses for furnace workshops, and an unpaid old account for the communal buildings' heating share.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维这才看清，粮煤也并不是一家的货。有村里合资买的粮，有两家货栈替炉坊存的煤，也有供暖公屋那份还没结清的旧账。

pairs.target: yígè chuān huī yī de nǚrén wèn , ruò dōu àn dōngchǔ pái , zǎo fùqián de dà huòzhàn huì buhuì bǎ hái còu bùqí qián de cūn liáng yòu jǐ dào hòumiàn . liángshāng zhāngzuǐ yào dá , tā yǐ bǎ zìjǐ de dānzi dìshàngqù le .
pairs.english: A woman in gray asked whether, if everything was scheduled as winter reserves, big warehouses that paid early would push village grain still short of funds to the back again. The grain merchant opened his mouth to answer, but she had already handed up her own order.
pairs.hanzi: 一个穿灰衣的女人问，若都按冬储排，早付钱的大货栈会不会把还凑不齐钱的村粮又挤到后面。粮商张嘴要答，她已把自己的单子递上去了。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng bèijiào dào qiánmiàn shí , méiyǒu shuō nǎjiā gèng gāi xiān zǒu . tā xiān jiāng xiànyǒu chēcì tóng běipō ràoxíng de rìzi liè kāi , yòu jiào tǎ wéi bǎ xiè xiāng de jìlù nálái .
pairs.english: When Ruan Heng was called forward, he didn't say which party deserved to go first. He first listed the existing cart departures and northern-slope detour days, then asked Tavi to bring the crate-unloading records.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡被叫到前面时，没有说哪家更该先走。他先将现有车次同北坡绕行的日子列开，又叫塔维把卸箱的记录拿来。

pairs.target: yǒurén tīngjiàn liǎngtóu dōu yǒu tuōjià , biàn wèn shìfǒu kěyǐ měibān duō jiē jǐxiāng , dǐdiào zǎobān kòngquē .
pairs.english: Hearing that there were cradles at both ends, someone asked whether each slot could take a few more crates to make up the missing morning capacity.
pairs.hanzi: 有人听见两头都有托架，便问是否可以每班多接几箱，抵掉早班空缺。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shǒuzhǐ yāzhù zhǐ , xiān kàn le ruǎn héng yìyǎn . ruǎn héng diǎntóu ràng tā shuō .
pairs.english: Tavi pressed a finger on the paper, first glancing at Ruan Heng. Ruan Heng nodded for him to speak.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维手指压住纸，先看了阮衡一眼。阮衡点头让他说。

pairs.target: " zhèxiē shùzhī jìguò zhè jǐzhǒng xiāngdǐ , zhè jǐdàng qīngzǎi . " tā shuō , " shǎo yícì chāi xiāng , yě háiyào bǎ xiāngzǐ bǎihǎo , zài xiè dào fēn huòjià shàng . búshì suǒyǒu huò dōu néng cóng zhèlǐ shěng chū yíyàng de gōngfū . "
pairs.english: “These figures only cover these few crate bases and light-load ranges,” he said. “Even with one less unpacking, the crates must still be positioned and unloaded onto the sorting rack. Not every cargo can save the same time here.”
pairs.hanzi: “这些数只记过这几种箱底、这几档轻载。”他说，“少一次拆箱，也还要把箱子摆好，再卸到分货架上。不是所有货都能从这里省出一样的工夫。”

pairs.target: tā bǎ dìèrzhī tuōjià shìyùn de yè fānkāi , ràng wènhuà de rén kàn zàizhòng lán . nà rén méiyǒu zài jiānchí , què wèn ruò bǎ méi chāichéng xiǎoxiāng shìfǒu kěxíng .
pairs.english: He opened the second cradle's trial page, showing the questioner the load column. The man didn't insist further, but asked whether dividing the coal into small crates would work.
pairs.hanzi: 他把第二只托架试运的页翻开，让问话的人看载重栏。那人没有再坚持，却问若把煤拆成小箱是否可行。

pairs.target: wēn xiù jīnrì bú zài , ruǎn héng méi tì tā yìng xià , zhī shuō xū lìng hé xiāngdǐ , xièhuò hé fēnzhuāng de gōngshí , bùnéng xiān bǎ hái méi zuò guò de kuài suàn jìn bān biǎo .
pairs.english: Wenxiu wasn't there today; Ruan Heng didn't agree on her behalf, saying only that crate bases, unloading and repacking labor must be checked separately: they couldn't count untested speed into the timetable in advance.
pairs.hanzi: 温岫今日不在，阮衡没替她应下，只说须另核箱底、卸货和分装的工时，不能先把还没做过的快算进班表。

pairs.target: xià róng shì zài yì dào sòngxìn shí lái de , zhàn dào tǎ wéi shēnhòu , xiédǐ hái dài zhe shī ní .
pairs.english: Xiarong arrived as they discussed mail delivery, standing behind Tavi, wet mud still on her soles.
pairs.hanzi: 夏绒是在议到送信时来的，站到塔维身后，鞋底还带着湿泥。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu ná zìjǐ zuórì nà tàng qù bǐ dōng liáng qīngzhòng , zhī wèn gùdìng shōujiàn ruò bèi nuó dào xiàwǔ , nǎxiē pùzi néng wǎn guānmén , gǎi yuē yóu shuí qù shuō .
pairs.english: She didn't compare yesterday's trip with the importance of winter grain, asking only which shops could close later if scheduled collections moved to afternoon, and who would arrange the changed appointments.
pairs.hanzi: 她没有拿自己昨日那趟去比冬粮轻重，只问固定收件若被挪到下午，哪些铺子能晚关门，改约由谁去说。

pairs.target: qiánpái yǒurén shuō xìndài kě dā huò zǒu , tā biàn wèn , ruò dā zǒu le , rén dào bùliǎo shōujiàn chù , shuí lái shōuhuí zhí . tīnglǐ yìshí zhī shèng bǐjiān guā zhǐ de shēngxiǎng .
pairs.english: Someone at the front said mailbags could travel with cargo; she asked who would collect the receipt if the bag went but the courier couldn't reach the receiving address. For a moment only the scratch of pen tips on paper remained in the hall.
pairs.hanzi: 前排有人说信袋可搭货走，她便问，若搭走了，人到不了收件处，谁来收回执。厅里一时只剩笔尖刮纸的声响。

pairs.target: dào wǔqián , qiángshàng de yuè biǎo bèi gǎichéng liǎngzhōu . měizhōu liǎnggè zǎobān xiān liúgěi cūn liáng yǔ gōngwū gòngnuǎn méi , huòzhàn tì sījiā cún de nà fèn lìng pái ; míngdān xū tiē chū , dào bān qián réng yǒu kòngwèi biàn zhào yuán shùnxù bǔhuò .
pairs.english: By late morning, the wall's monthly schedule had become two weeks. Two morning slots a week would first be reserved for village grain and communal-building heating coal, with private stockpiles at warehouses scheduled separately; lists must be posted, and any space still free before a slot would take other cargo in the original order.
pairs.hanzi: 到午前，墙上的月表被改成两周。每周两个早班先留给村粮与公屋供暖煤，货栈替私家存的那份另排；名单须贴出，到班前仍有空位便照原顺序补货。

pairs.target: xiānhuò lìng liú yítàng wǔqián jiēbó , sòngxìn de gùdìng shōujiàn shíduàn zhúhù héduì , bùnéng zhī zài zǒngbiǎo shàng wǎnghòu yí huà jiùsuàn gǎi wán . shí bèi nà tóu yě xū zhàobiǎo huí hé , dìsānzhōu shìfǒu xù pái , zài bǎ shíjì wùdiǎn yǔ jī huò dài huílái yì .
pairs.english: Fresh produce would get a separate late-morning connection; scheduled mail collections must be checked household by household, rather than considered settled by simply shifting them back on the master chart. Shibei must also check its end against the schedule; whether to continue for a third week would be discussed using actual delays and accumulated cargo.
pairs.hanzi: 鲜货另留一趟午前接驳，送信的固定收件时段逐户核对，不能只在总表上往后一画就算改完。石背那头也须照表回核，第三周是否续排，再把实际误点与积货带回来议。

pairs.target: yǒurén xián liǎngbān tài shǎo , yǒurén xián shì liǎngzhōu réng tài cháng . dǒng lǐshì shōuqǐ méiyǒu cǎiyòng de yuè biǎo , jiào liǎngbiān dōu bǎ fǎnduì dehuà liúxià . sànhuì shí , bào kuāng de rén tóng liángshāng yìqiányīhòu chūmén , shuí yě méi xiān ràng shuí .
pairs.english: Some thought two slots too few, others that even a two-week trial was too long. Director Dong put away the unused monthly chart, asking both sides to leave their objections on record. When the meeting ended, the basket holder and grain merchant went out one behind the other, neither offering to let the other go first.
pairs.hanzi: 有人嫌两班太少，有人嫌试两周仍太长。董理事收起没有采用的月表，叫两边都把反对的话留下。散会时，抱筐的人同粮商一前一后出门，谁也没先让谁。

pairs.target: huíqù de lùshang , tǎ wéi wèn ruǎn héng , wèishénme yì kāishǐ bù bǎ zìjǐ zànchéng de páifǎ shuō chūlái .
pairs.english: On the way back, Tavi asked Ruan Heng why he hadn't stated his preferred schedule at the start.
pairs.hanzi: 回去的路上，塔维问阮衡，为什么一开始不把自己赞成的排法说出来。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng jiāng shǒulǐ de zhǐ huàn le yìbiān , cái shuō zìjǐ yě búshì quán wú piānxīn : ruò zǎobān tài luàn , hé lù suǒ de rén dé tì jǐtóu láihuí shōushí , tā zìrán gèng xiǎngyào yìzhāng róngyì bàn de biǎo .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng shifted the papers to his other hand before saying he wasn't without bias: if morning departures became chaotic, Joint Routes Office staff would have to sort things out back and forth for several parties, so naturally he wanted a schedule that was easier to administer.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡将手里的纸换了一边，才说自己也不是全无偏心：若早班太乱，合路所的人得替几头来回收拾，他自然更想要一张容易办的表。

pairs.target: " kě róngyì bàn , bújiàndé shì tāmen róngyì guò . " tǎ wéi shuō .
pairs.english: “But easy to administer doesn't necessarily mean easy for them to live with,” Tavi said.
pairs.hanzi: “可容易办，不见得是他们容易过。”塔维说。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng kàn le tā yìyǎn . " suǒyǐ wǒ yě zuòzài lǐmiàn , bùnéng zhī jiào biérén shuō míngbái . " tā zǒu le jǐbù , yòu shuō , " búguò nǐ fāngcái kàn wǒ de nà yíxià , yě tài xiàng yào wǒ tì nǐ dá le . "
pairs.english: Ruan Heng glanced at him. “That's why I sit in there too. I can't demand clarity only of others.” After a few steps he added, “But that look you gave me just now seemed awfully like wanting me to answer for you.”
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡看了他一眼。“所以我也坐在里面，不能只叫别人说明白。”他走了几步，又说，“不过你方才看我的那一下，也太像要我替你答了。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi liǎnshàng rè qǐlái , shuō zìjǐ zhǐshì pà shuōcuò . ruǎn héng méi zài zhuī , wèn tā wǔfàn xiǎng chī shénme . zǒu dào fànpù ménkǒu , liǎng réncái fāxiàn dōu hái zuàn zhe yào jiāohuíqù de jìlù , shuí yě méi téng chūshǒu xiān ménlián .
pairs.english: Tavi's face grew hot; he said he was only afraid of saying something wrong. Ruan Heng didn't pursue it, asking what he wanted for lunch. At the eatery's door, both realized they still clutched the records they must return, neither with a hand free to lift the door curtain.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维脸上热起来，说自己只是怕说错。阮衡没再追，问他午饭想吃什么。走到饭铺门口，两人才发现都还攥着要交回去的记录，谁也没腾出手掀门帘。
